about.heroDesc: A character building platform for big-hearted individuals, upholding humanitarian values, and fully dedicated to nature conservation at Telkom University.
about.year1998Desc: Born from the longing of students for the jungle at STMB Bandung. MAPURI (Mahasiswa Penempuh Rimba) became the foundation of a timeless brotherhood.
about.year2002Desc: The institutional change to IM Telkom brought a name change. PERIMATRIK was born with a new spirit, carrying the explorer spirit on a more established campus organization scale.
about.year2013Desc: Telkom University was officially established. PERIMATRIK merged into the Student Activity Unit of the Faculty of Industrial Engineering, expanding networks and bringing the mission of nature conservation to a broader academic realm.
about.philosophyDesc: Every footprint we leave in the wild is not just a physical adventure, but a spiritual journey and leadership character building.
about.lambangDesc: The PERIMATRIK symbol is an identity that represents steadfastness of soul, courage, brotherhood, and responsibility towards the environment. A symbol of pride that binds the unity of all members.
about.meaningCompassDesc: Compass as a clear direction of purpose.
about.meaningMountainDesc: Three mountain peaks representing the Tri Dharma of Higher Education.
about.meaningRopeDesc: Circular rope as an unbroken brotherhood.
about.coreValuesDesc: Our main foundation in building the character of each member, creating tough individuals in the wild and adaptive ones in social life.
about.valueReligiusDesc: Instilling religious values as a main guide.
about.valueSosialDesc: Fostering care for others through community service.
about.valueIntelektualDesc: Balancing adventure with education and academic achievement.
about.resosolDesc: This concept is the pillar of PERIMATRIK activities. Through outdoor activities, we invite members to enjoy and be grateful for nature, care for the surrounding environment, train themselves to be tough and disciplined, and test ideas with a measurable approach.
